title: Caprese Salad
description: Caprese Salad is a timeless Italian classic that celebrates the beauty of simplicity. Juicy ripe tomatoes, creamy buffalo mozzarella, fragrant fresh basil, and premium extra virgin olive oil come together to create a light yet elegant dish. Finished with aged balsamic vinegar, sea salt, and freshly ground black pepper, this refreshing salad showcases the quality of each ingredient and is a staple of fine Italian dining.

ingredients.title: Main Ingredients
items: 3 ripe heirloom tomatoes (mixed colors for visual impact: red, yellow, green)
250g (9 oz) fresh buffalo mozzarella (or burrata for a luxurious twist)
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil (cold-pressed, single origin if possible)
1 tbsp aged balsamic vinegar (traditional, syrupy consistency)
Fleur de sel (or Maldon sea salt flakes)

ingredients.title: Optional Enhancements for Fine Dining Presentation
items: Basil oil (blend basil leaves with olive oil, strain for a vivid green drizzle)
Microgreens or basil sprouts for garnish
Crushed pistachios or pine nuts for texture
Edible flowers (e.g., nasturtium, viola) for elegance

instruction.title: Step 1 – Tomatoes
steps: Slice heirloom tomatoes into even rounds (~½ cm thick).
Season lightly with salt and let rest 5 minutes to release juices and intensify flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Mozzarella/Burrata
steps: If using mozzarella: slice into rounds of similar thickness.
If using burrata: tear gently into rustic chunks for creaminess.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assembly
steps: On a chilled plate, alternate tomato and mozzarella slices in a circular pattern.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finishing Touches
steps: Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and aged balsamic (or dot artistically around the plate).
Sprinkle with sea salt and freshly cracked pepper.
For refinement: add drops of basil oil, scatter microgreens, and a few edible flowers.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as an appetizer or light lunch.
Pairs beautifully with crusty Italian bread or focaccia.
Enjoy alongside grilled meats, seafood, or a glass of chilled white wine.

chefTips: Use tomatoes at room temperature (never refrigerated) for maximum flavor.
If possible, source PDO-certified Buffalo Mozzarella from Campania.
For dramatic plating, serve on a black slate or white porcelain plate to contrast colors.
Balance flavors: sweet tomatoes, creamy mozzarella, bright basil, umami balsamic.
Apply olive oil just before serving so it glistens, not soggy.
